description: Diversity exists in India in the form of language, gender, culture, class, religion etc. When NITI Aayog introduced the #AIforAll initiative, it was to overcome all of this diversity and ensure the access of AI to the roots.
body_lead: Results for " Diversity exists in India in language, gender, culture, class, religion etc. When NITI Aayog introduced the #AIforAll initiative, it was to overcome all of this diversity and ensure the access of AI to the roots. The government has introduced measures to decentralise technology with many entities working towards it. This is the story of a young woman teaching students the significance of AI.
